lines.say: Every pull you log is full of answers.
E-S-O Logs records all of it. Every hit, every heal, every buff.
E-S-O Toolkit reads that same log, and shows you what it means. Just paste the link.
Here's one tank's gear in E-S-O Logs. Thirteen items, one per row. E-S-O Toolkit groups them into sets, lays out both skill bars the way they look in game, and checks the build for common mistakes.
That scribed skill? E-S-O Toolkit works out its focus, signature and affix scripts from the fight itself.
E-S-O Logs replays a fight from above. E-S-O Toolkit rebuilds it in 3D. Orbit the arena, follow any player, and rewatch the moment that mattered.
Then send any build to the editor, and check the math with the built-in calculators.
E-S-O Logs records the fight. E-S-O Toolkit helps you understand it. Free, at E-S-O-T-K dot com.
